mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in a month, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals contraction in consumer demand amid monetary tightening, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, it signals robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals weak residential construction and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 10% in a month, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS increases over 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals monetary tightening causing economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market deterioration
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals the central bank's commitment to controlling inflation, reducing market uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
